_comment: Registry of repos with an alembic backend, read by qa/gate_migrations.py. Paths are relative to the clone root except 'venv' (relative to backend_dir). 'env' holds NON-SECRET placeholders only; the gate runs repo code with a scrubbed environment plus these values and DATABASE_URL pointing at the throwaway postgres. Verified 2026-10-01 by reading each repo's alembic.ini + alembic/env.py on the GPU box clones.

billwatch.metadata: alembic/env.py does `import app.main` then target_metadata = app.database.Base.metadata
billwatch.notes: app/database.py builds an ASYNC engine at import, so DATABASE_URL must be asyncpg-flavoured; env.py rewrites it to psycopg2 for alembic (psycopg2-binary is in the venv). The repo dir `billwatch-backend/alembic/` is also a python package that shadows the alembic library if the repo dir is first on sys.path - _migr_helper.py imports alembic before touching sys.path. 2026-09-14 prod 500 (model/DB drift) happened here.

gitlark.metadata: alembic/env.py imports app.core.database.Base plus an explicit list of app.models.* modules
gitlark.notes: env.py uses create_async_engine on DATABASE_URL (asyncpg only; venv has no psycopg2). Revision ids are numeric ('024'). Import warns about SECRET_KEY unset (harmless). Known pre-existing drift: String(36) model columns vs UUID migration columns.

iptv_apps.metadata: alembic/env.py does `import app.main` then target_metadata = app.database.Base.metadata
iptv_apps.notes: app.database reads DATABASE_URL and derives a sync psycopg2 URL for alembic. Revision ids are long slugs (e.g. 0004_add_dunning_tracking_columns, 33 chars) which overflow alembic_version.version_num varchar(32) on Postgres (SQLite never notices).

test-automation-agent.metadata: alembic/env.py does `import app.main` then target_metadata = app.core.database.Base.metadata
test-automation-agent.notes: async env.py (async_engine_from_config) -> asyncpg URL. backend/ also holds a stale `venv/` dir; `.venv` is the maintained one. entrypoint.sh swallows a failed upgrade and falls back to create_all(), so a broken chain can hide in prod - exactly why the empty-DB upgrade is gated here.
